items.title: Spend inputs and notice match dry run

source.label: Local council inputs
filters: Supplier total times 4 strictly above GBP 25000
Redacted and missing supplier names excluded
Strict buyer names: West Berkshire Council or West Berkshire
Live filter: contract end on or after 1 May 2026, or blank
caveats: Dry run retains non-procurement payments and repeated spend rows.
Case-insensitive buyer filtering increases live matched suppliers from 32 to 33.
An unmatched supplier is not evidence of off-contract spend.

queries.summary: Aggregate workbook profiling and exact normalized supplier-name coverage.

preview.note: Counts of supplier groups, not transaction rows.
